plan_cache_findings.canonical_proposal_storage: GraceExecutionService calls pipeline.record_proposal at resident_execution/service.py:454 after reasoner returns; pipeline.py:547 persists the accepted typed proposal. plan_cache_findings.design: Keep the current assignment plan in legacy plans; archive every other plan entry in deterministic zlib level-9/base64 canonical JSON with version 1 and SHA256. Merge archived then legacy, with legacy/current values winning overlaps caused by old-runtime rollback updates. Next encode archives the merged map once; no plan keys or values are dropped.
plan_cache_findings.outcome_policy: No capacity-driven plan eviction or ordering change. Existing bounded outcome retention (last 32, with its existing size fallback) remains unchanged. The observed current single outcome is preserved in the tested fixture.
plan_cache_findings.rollback: An older runtime ignores plans_archive_v1 but preserves it as an unknown runtime field while writing. The current assignment remains visible in legacy plans. Older archived plans remain byte-preserved and are merged when the new runtime returns; the old runtime cannot use those archived entries as prior-plan prompt context during rollback.
